steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ on the buyer side.
Open the Recreate Order dialog from the event's stage settings.

args.goal: In the Recreate Order dialog, keep the bidding duration at 30 minutes, select 45 minutes for Evaluation Duration, click Create Order, and stop on the resulting event screen showing a 30-minute bidding duration followed by a 45-minute evaluation window.

steps.note: Configure and submit the recreate order, then verify the resulting event shows the requested evaluation window.
Confirm the recreated order completed without an application error.
